llm.summary: The skill artifacts are coherent operational guidance and helper tooling with disclosed, purpose-aligned sensitive actions and explicit user gates.

dimensions.detail: The skills match their stated purposes: Convex setup/migrations/audits, ClawHub moderation and content-rights workflows, documentation review, and autoreview. High-impact admin, email, production migration, and AI-review capabilities are described directly rather than hidden.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions repeatedly require explicit targets, reasons, dry runs, confirmation before writes, audit/logging paths, backup gates for destructive production migration work, and verification after changes.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Artifacts are plain .agents/skills directories with SKILL.md files, references, icons, optional agent metadata, and an explicit autoreview script. I found no install hook, obfuscated loader, or automatic execution path.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Some workflows use networked provider/admin CLIs, production Convex deployments, GitHub state, and external AI review engines. That access is expected for the stated purposes and is bounded by user-directed commands and safety checks.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skills can guide privileged staff actions and temporary migration code, but they do not establish background persistence. The autoreview helper uses temporary files and includes isolation, read-only review prompts, secret checks, and cleanup behavior.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you want ClawHub/Convex operational automation and AI-assisted review workflows. Users should be careful with the staff moderation, email, and production migration skills because they can guide real account, content, and production data changes, but the artifacts require explicit approval and verification before those actions.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector clean result] expected: No advisory issues were reported, and artifact review did not reveal hidden or purpose-mismatched behavior.
[VirusTotal clean telemetry] expected: The supplied engine telemetry was clean; this is consistent with the inspected plain-text skill artifacts and scripts.
